rv.q: This indie musical for kids deftly channels the freewheeling silliness of Dav Pilkey’s graphic novels.
The Dog Man books are chaotic, hilarious and full of pathos, but writer/lyricist Aguila and composer Brad Alexander’s show leans largely on the former.
However, if you’re just looking for some lo-fi family-friendly fun with a few good songs, I’d hold on for panto season.

cn.t: Dog Man: The Musical successfully brings Dav Pilkey's beloved graphic novels to the stage, deftly capturing the freewheeling silliness and imaginative spirit that has made the series a sensation with primary school audiences.
